svg.title: Financial ABM · Policy meets markets. Who greenwashes, and why?
svg.desc: 政策与市场双轮驱动下的 ESG 转型：一个可审计的多智能体人工市场。右侧企业球为结构示意，不是实时数据。A multi-agent artificial market for ESG transition and greenwashing; the firm sphere on the right is a structural schematic, not live data.
svg.text: 政策与市场双轮驱动下的 ESG 转型：一个可审计的多智能体人工市场
Heterogeneous investors and firms trade, learn and evolve; policy is the
controlled variable, and every result cites its evidence.

200 synthetic firms · colour = choice · size = market cap

真实改善、漂绿与维持的博弈
